confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain and is set for the July monsoon off-season, when Kathmandu demand is lower. Cocktail and wine_glass are scaled from the beer estimate because direct knowledge is weaker. Taxes and service charges are assumed to be included.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Kathmandu's Thamel and other central tourist-visitor areas, benchmarked against other South Asian visitor hubs with similar backpacker and mid-range hotel tiers. Adjusted for July monsoon off-season demand.
